text:
Ava: Evercrest reached out — they want a PoC to replace CompetitorX. Main asks: API parity, security questionnaire, and a short pricing commitment. Can we sketch a PoC ops plan?
Ben: I can run the parity tests. Request: 400 prompts from Evercrest, ideally split by use-case (summarization, Q&A, code).
Priya: Send over their sec questionnaire. Key checks: KMS, retention, logs, SOC2. We also need to confirm whether PII can be redacted automatically.
Ava: Uploaded doc: https://rwd.internal/secq/evercrest-jan2026.pdf
Leo: Infra: they want a dedicated pool and CIDR allowlist. I can provision but need CIDR + contact email for IP assignment. ETA ~36-48h after we get that.
Nate: Pricing: propose a 60-day PoC blended rate with a committed token estimate and overage terms. I'll draft a one-page pricing addendum.
Ben: For the shim proxy, I'll provide a tiny adapter that accepts CompetitorX-style payloads and maps to Redwood endpoints. Example curl to validate:
```
curl -X POST https://poc-evercrest.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<text>","max_tokens":150}'
```
Ben: We'll capture outputs, token usage, and a simple similarity metric to flag big deltas.
Priya: Security asks: exact retention window (we keep prompts 30 days by default, redact on request), pen test summary (redacted PDF available), and KMS integration (customer keys supported via KMS). I'll prepare artifacts.
Ava: Legal flagged EU data residency and indemnity for hallucinations as blockers.
Priya: Residency: route EU users to eu-west region for PoC. Indemnity: legal will propose standard enterprise language; we'll mark hallucination carve-outs.
Leo: infra-bot: [provision] poc-evercrest cluster queued by leo_eng  estimated 36h to IP allocation.
Nate: Timeline: They asked for kickoff Monday and a 10-business-day PoC. Doable if prompts + CIDR arrive by kickoff.
Ben: Agree. I'll build the eval harness and post the repo link + run instructions prior to kickoff.
Ava: Great. Next steps: 1) Evercrest to send CIDR + prompts, 2) Priya to share redacted SOC2 + pen test, 3) Nate to send pricing addendum draft, 4) Ben to post harness. Sync tomorrow 9am PT.
Priya: I'll have redacted reports ready EOD.
Ben: Repo link incoming EOD.
Ava: Thanks team.
